protocol.measurement_boundary: Exact RTL request counters and final-prefix-token admission through acceptance of its last vocabulary score.
protocol.quality_gate: Exact weighted products, sums, rounding, tags, scores, cache values, bytes, stops and directed faults.
protocol.tokenizer: BOS plus two hex digit IDs per input UTF-8 byte. Useful outputs are byte IDs and exclude EOS.
protocol.warmup: Pinned model loaded and legacy BOS run before the tested request

quality.evidence: All frozen scores, token bytes, stop geometry and cache values matched.
